claim_limits: Equal parameters do not imply equal compute, latency, physical fit or learning utility.
Sharing changes parameter reuse as well as access density; report its interaction with independent-reader arms.
CPU fixture tests are not native Spark competence.
native_successor_requirements: Qualified useful two-site readout and correction evidence.
Separate per-arm execution, source, scorer, numerical, resource, authorization and output bindings.
Fixed identical evidence, selected slots, data splits, writer, updates, template, thinking mode and generation budget.
Measure every source encode, retrieval, store publication, teacher target, update, probe and restart; preserve raw answers.
One native worker; 50GiB driver, 512MiB sustained swap-growth, 15percent host-free; no reuse of consumed v11 output.

matched_total_cost_followup.calibration: Use independent unlabeled fitting-like pilot inputs; bind counts and ceilings in a new packet before any pilot. Restore the common initial extension after the pilot. Charge pilot cost.
matched_total_cost_followup.freeze_before_labels: Use measured per-arm fixed and marginal teaching costs to predeclare a balanced whole-pass schedule under the same total cost envelope before opening fitting/development outcomes. No observed-answer early stopping or schedule adjustment.
matched_total_cost_followup.matching_tolerance: Declare the allowed measured-cost tolerance and treatment of envelope breaches before launch. An arm outside tolerance is unmatched evidence, never an assumed matched-cost success.
matched_total_cost_followup.exposure_caveat: Equal total-cost runs may have different update exposure; keep the equal-exposure primary comparison separate and report both.
matched_total_cost_followup.no_inference: Parameter arithmetic or nominal operation counts cannot establish measured total-cost matching.
